parts.html: The K-36 kitchen model combines a contemporary L-shaped layout with graphite upper cabinets, light grey lower fronts, and a tall light-colored unit on the right. The contrast between the dark upper cabinetry and the lighter lower sections creates a distinctive two-tone composition, while the dark stone-effect countertop visually connects both sides of the kitchen.

Rather than relying on a uniform grey finish, K-36 uses several coordinated tones. The graphite upper cabinets establish a strong horizontal line, the light grey lower fronts make the main cabinetry appear less visually heavy, and the tall light-colored unit on the right balances the overall arrangement.

The supplied visualization also shows open shelves within the upper cabinet row. These alternate with closed storage and can accommodate frequently used items or small decorative objects. Black horizontal cabinet handles reinforce the darker details of the design.

K-36 has an L-shaped configuration, with cabinetry arranged along two adjoining walls. This makes use of the corner and allows work surfaces, storage, and built-in appliance spaces to be distributed between two sections.

The kitchen has a total linear length of 4.1 meters, with standard dimensions of 4.1 × 2.4 × 0.6 m. During individual planning, the locations of the sink, hob, refrigerator, and other built-in appliances can be determined according to room dimensions and plumbing and electrical connections.
A separate kitchen island is not included in the standard configuration. The main working and storage functions are organized within the L-shaped furniture composition.

Both upper and lower cabinet fronts are made from laminated particleboard. The upper row has a predominantly graphite and dark grey finish, while the lower cabinets are light grey. The tall side unit on the right also has a light-colored finish.

The cabinet structure uses 18 mm laminated particleboard. The countertop is chipboard-based, with a dark stone-effect decorative surface. The stone appearance describes its finish; natural stone is not specified as the material of the standard countertop.
A pull-out cargo storage system is included in the standard K-36 configuration. It supplements conventional cabinets and provides accessible storage for food and kitchen essentials.

Hinged cabinet doors use Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close. Pull-out elements are fitted with Muller telescopic runners without soft-close. Cabinet handles are included. Lift mechanisms are not part of the standard specification.

K-36 can be customized beyond its standard materials and hardware. Upon request, clients can choose more functional furniture fittings, upgraded opening mechanisms, and additional storage systems. Alternative materials are also available, ranging from budget-friendly options to premium finishes. The shades of grey, cabinet and countertop materials, and internal fittings can be selected according to individual requirements and project budget.
K-36 Kitchen Specifications — Standard Configuration
Color: Grey, with graphite upper cabinets and light grey lower fronts
Style: Contemporary
Configuration: L-shaped / corner kitchen
Countertop: Chipboard-based, with a dark stone-effect finish
Dimensions: 4.1 × 2.4 × 0.6 m
Lift mechanism: None
Appliances: Designed for built-in appliances
Cargo storage: Yes
Handles: Included
Upper cabinet fronts: Laminated particleboard with graphite and dark grey finish
Lower cabinet fronts: Laminated particleboard with light grey finish
Cabinet construction: 18 mm laminated particleboard
Linear length: 4.1 m
Kitchen island: No
Hinges: Muller Profi Line with soft-close
Finish: Two-tone — graphite upper cabinetry, light grey lower cabinets, and a tall light-colored unit on the right
Drawer runners: Muller telescopic runners without soft-close
Additional visible design features: Open upper shelves, black horizontal handles, and a dark stone-effect countertop

Optional upgrades: more functional furniture hardware, improved opening mechanisms, additional storage systems, and alternative materials ranging from budget-friendly to premium. These options are selected separately from the standard specification.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments and private residences in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-36 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, with adjustments to cabinet runs, worktop arrangements, appliance positions, and storage. Clients can also select alternative shades of grey, cabinet and countertop materials, furniture hardware, and internal fittings.

Our services include kitchen planning, material and hardware selection, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. Sinks, taps, extractor hoods, and household appliances can also be selected upon request.
